name: password_reset
description: The example document: ambiguity, a contradiction, missing outcomes and an expiry rule without its failure path. The scripted model proposes useful questions, a duplicate, invented numbers and IDs, a fabricated quote and unsupported test cases.
requirements:
REQ-1: The user can request a password reset from the login page by entering their email address.
REQ-2: The system must send a reset link to the registered email address.
REQ-3: The reset link expires after 30 minutes.
REQ-4: The new password must be at least 8 characters long and contain one digit.
REQ-5: The reset page should load fast and be user-friendly.
REQ-6: After too many failed attempts, the account is locked.
REQ-7: The new password must be at least 10 characters long.
REQ-8: If the email address is not registered, the system shows a generic message to avoid revealing which accounts exist.
REQ-9: The user is able to set a new password.

issues.note: what the user sees after requesting a reset
how a locked account is unlocked
outcome of setting a new password

rule.contradiction.REQ-4+REQ-7.value: REQ-7: The new password must be at least 10 characters long.

rule.missing_expected_result.REQ-1.value: A confirmation message says a reset link was sent if the address is registered.

rule.missing_error_handling.REQ-1.value: An invalid email address format shows an inline error and no email is sent.

rule.ambiguous_wording.REQ-5.value: The reset page is interactive within 2 seconds.

rule.missing_expected_result.REQ-9.value: The user is signed in with the new password.

answers_by_text.value: The page says the link has expired and offers to send a new one.

questions.question: What happens when the user opens a reset link after it has expired?
questions.reason: The negative test for REQ-3 needs the expected outcome.

questions.question: Should the account be locked after 5 failed attempts?
How is a locked account unlocked, and how long does the lock last?
Does REQ-12 apply to single sign-on users?
questions.reason: Points at a requirement that does not exist.

findings.fix: State the load time the author confirmed.

steps: Fail to sign in five times
